problems.quote: If a second statement supplies the parity of k or a bound like k < 10, the exact exponent becomes known.
problems.problem: For 3^k ≡ 7 (mod 10), k ≡ 3 (mod 4). A bound k<10 gives k=3 or 7 (not unique); parity adds no information since k≡3 (mod 4) already implies k is odd.
problems.correction: A bound like k<10 may not give a unique exponent (k=3 or 7); parity adds no new information.
problems.verifierReason: Original claims bound/parity gives unique exponent; counterexample shows not unique. Correction accurate.

problems.correction: When three sets A, B, C are involved, the Venn diagram has eight disjoint regions (including the outside).
